invariants.rationale: Method expects a HoodieData<WriteStatus> parameter, which is likely non-null in normal operation.
Engine context is a required argument for compaction-related methods and is almost certainly required to be non-null.
Configuration is almost always required and probably necessary for method logic.
A valid instant time parameter is typically necessary for correct compaction semantics.
The instant time should be a non-empty string representing a timestamp/commit instant.
